title: How I Got a Refund from Educative — A Lesson in Communication
excerpt: Accidentally bought the annual plan instead of monthly. Here's how polite communication saved my student budget.
content:
Accidentally bought the annual plan on Educative instead of the monthly one 😅

As a student, every dollar counts, so I reached out to their support and explained my situation. They granted a one-time courtesy refund — proof that polite, clear communication works.

## Big Thanks

Big thanks to the Educative team for their understanding! 🙌

## Lesson Learned

Mistakes happen, but honesty and professionalism can go a long way.

If you ever find yourself in a similar situation, don't hesitate to reach out politely and explain your case. The worst they can say is no, but you might be surprised by the outcome!

title: Welcome to My Blog

content:
